title: Went in the trash... even the company didn’t want it back!
text: Went in the trash... even the company didn’t want it back!. This crock is a crock alright!  A crock of...  the inside paint was all chipping off.  The most I wiped it with a damp paper towel the more paint came off.  Never even attempted to put butter in it!!! Started a return and they gave us our money back. Told us not to bother to send it back.  Went in the trash!

product_metadata.title: BonCera, Stoneware Butter Hold Crock, Handmade Porcelain Butter Keeping in Water - French Butter Dish Holder -Black
